name: Charleston (West Virginia, United States)
description: Bright yellow field with a light blue border, charged at the centre with the city arms with a red scroll reading CHARLESTON and green oak leaves, in imitation of the West Virginia flag.
history: Charleston is the capital and most populous city of West Virginia. The flag was adopted in 1970 (adopted unofficially in 1970, according to Flags of the World quoting American City Flags).

features.role: city arms with a red scroll reading CHARLESTON and oak leaves
